fieldValues.title: composition.json already contradicts itself on containerId traversal
fieldValues.summary: docs/schema/2.0/composition.json documents the exact contradiction RFC-034 exists to resolve, inside the live schema rather than only in prose: DiscoveryQuery.containerid's description quotes the I-66 three-condition rule verbatim (root/member/transitive contains-Relation traversal), while the sibling containerScope description on the enclosing discovery-query SectionSource calls DiscoveryQuery.containerId single-valued and non-traversing one property away. containerScope's own subtree gloss also still reads traverse contains-relations from listed containers.
evidence: docs/schema/2.0/composition.json $defs.DiscoveryQuery.properties.containerId.description: "Instance is a member of this container per RFC-009 I-66: (1) instanceId in Container.rootInstanceIds[], OR (2) instanceId in Container.memberInstanceIds[], OR (3) reachable via transitive contains Relation traversal from any rootInstanceIds[] entry."

docs/schema/2.0/composition.json $defs.SectionSource oneOf[0].properties.containerScope.description: "...because DiscoveryQuery.containerId is single-valued and non-traversing..." and "'subtree' (v1: falls back to explicit with diagnostic when containerIds absent)... traverse contains-relations from listed containers"
Neither description was updated when srs#525 collapsed SectionSource onto DiscoveryQuery, so the two disagree on the exact question rfc-decision-0750c62f and RFC-034 Change D/R8 now resolve
fieldValues.body: Flagged in RFC-034 Rev 5 (rfcs/rfc-034-structural-container-composition.md, PR #616) under Change D items 1 and 2 as concrete Stage-6 remediation targets: correct DiscoveryQuery.containerId's description to state effective(C) rather than re-quote I-66, and correct containerScope's subtree gloss to name the childContainerIds recursion. Not fixed in PR #616 itself, since RFC-034 is still Draft and schema edits are out of scope before acceptance.
